tools.name: visual_save
tools.description: Save a picture someone sent you into your visual library, so you can use it as a reference when drawing. Only pictures from whitelisted senders can be saved. Pictures of the same person or thing go under the same id; use "self" for yourself.

image.description: The exact log: blob handle of the picture in the conversation.

id.description: Short entry id, e.g. "self" or "团子". An existing id adds the picture to that entry.

name.description: Display name; omit to keep the current one.

aliases.description: Other names people use for it; omit to keep the current ones.

description.description: Appearance notes for the image model; omit to keep the current text.
